entities.name: Muzeum Stanisława Wyspiańskiego
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Stanisław Mateusz Ignacy Wyspiański was a Polish playwright, painter, poet, and interior and furniture designer. A patriotic writer, he created symbolic national dramas accordant with the artistic premises of the Young Poland movement.
